about: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation ones, as published. Every guide below is written for this app in our own words and says what it is based on; missable flags are reasoned from the official descriptions, and each flagged trophy carries its reasoning in its missableNote.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum, awarded on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned — the official description says exactly that ('You're a Leonida Legend') and asks for nothing extra. Work the roadmap stages in order, keep the five flagged missables in mind during the story, and this unlocks with your final trophy. Basis: the official description; cross-checked against the full list on PSNProfiles and Exophase.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. The official description names the mission and nothing else, so there is no side objective to chase: play the introduction through to its end and the trophy pops as the mission completes. It is the natural first stop of the roadmap's story stage. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Per the official description this is a pure story-progress trophy: finish every Chapter 1 mission in order, ending with the chapter's closing mission, and it unlocks. Nothing in the description asks for collectibles or side content along the way. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, the official description asks only for story completion: play Chapter 2's missions through to the chapter finale. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. The official description is a straight completion requirement, so keep following the story markers until the chapter closes; no optional content is named. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Per the official description, finish the chapter's story missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end; it names no extra condition. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story — one of only two golds on the list. The official description names the final mission itself, so this is the last step of the story stage: finish the campaign and it unlocks. Before you start the finale, glance at the missable flags in this guide, since the one-off moments belong to the story. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. The official description ties the trophy to that one named mission, so it unlocks as the mission ends when you reach it in the story; there is no separate objective in the description. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Per the official description, finishing that named heist mission is the whole requirement; it arrives as part of the story, so no preparation beyond reaching it is named. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The official description names the mission only, so play it through when the story offers it and the trophy unlocks at its end. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. As with the other named-mission trophies, the official description makes finishing that mission the entire requirement. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The official description names the mission; finish it in the story and the trophy unlocks. Note the separate trophy Catch Me If You Can, which also names VCIA and is flagged missable in this guide — the two are different requirements. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Per the official description, finishing that named mission is the whole task; it unlocks as the mission completes in the story stage. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% game completion — the list's second gold. The official description states the target plainly; in practice it means finishing the story and then clearing the game's own completion checklist (missions, strands, collectibles and activities of the kind this guide groups into stages 2 to 5). Use the in-game completion percentage as your measure and mop up by category; this tracker's filters mirror those same categories. Basis: the official description; category cross-check against PSNProfiles and Exophase.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the count is in the official description itself. This is a long cumulative grind rather than a single feat, so start early: take stunt opportunities as you cross Leonida during the story instead of leaving all 250 for the cleanup, and let the counter build in the background. Basis: the count and requirement are the official description's; the pacing advice is ours.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The official description asks for one attempt at every activity type, not mastery; the kit's official list data counts 9 activity types. Sample each type as it unlocks — a race, a range challenge, a drone race and so on — and the trophy completes when the last type has been tried. Basis: the official description and the activity-type count in the official list data.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them, the count PlayStation tracks for this trophy as listed in the official list data. Treat it as a skill set to chip away at: clear a range's challenges to learn its targets, then return for the gold scores once the layout is familiar, weapon by weapon. Basis: the official description and its tracked count of 42.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations, per the count in the official list data. A win is needed at each one, not just a finish, so learn a course with a practice run, then race it for the win before moving on; tick each location off in this tracker as you clear it. Basis: the official description and its location count of 14.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the count is the official description's own. 'Different' is the key word: repeating one easy race does not advance it, so spread your wins across distinct race events as they appear on the map, and keep count here. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The official description names the opponent and the contest: take Cal's fishing challenge when it is offered and out-fish him. It names no score or fish, so the whole task is winning that one head-to-head challenge. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. The official description asks for a completion, not a high score, so pick the shortest arcade game you find and see it through to its end screen. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand. The official description points at the end of one character's mission line, so work Andy's missions in order whenever they appear; the trophy unlocks when his last one is done. Strands like this also feed Strangers & Freaks and 100% completion. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Per the official description, follow Kenton's missions through to his last one; the trophy is for the strand's finale, not for starting it. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. The official description names Billy's last mission as the goal, so clear his strand in order; it counts toward the strand total behind Strangers & Freaks as well. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the count and the 'strands' wording are the official description's. A strand is a character's whole mission line, so finishing the strands behind the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone trophies in this list is the core of the eight; keep going with any other strangers you meet until the strand count reaches 8. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Per the official description, work Randy's missions in order to his finale; the trophy unlocks when that last mission ends. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. The official description makes Tyrone's last mission the goal; clear his strand in order alongside the other stranger strands in stage 2 of the roadmap. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots, per the count in the official list data. This is a collectible-style sweep: meditate whenever you pass a spot rather than hunting all 18 at the end, and use this tracker's count to see how many remain. Basis: the official description and its spot count of 18.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. The official description ties the trophy to one specific hunt handed to you by Bret, so take his hunting request when it appears and bring that one animal down; ordinary hunting does not substitute for the unique one he names. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — the set count is the official description's. Cards come in sets, so gather them steadily as you explore and finish whole sets rather than scattering singles; three completed sets, not three cards, is the target. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — the count is the official description's own. A pure coverage grind: use it whenever you reach a new location so the hundred builds up during normal play, and leave any remainder for a deliberate sweep in the collectibles stage of the roadmap. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the count is in the official description. Challenges are the game's short-form tasks, so clear them as they surface instead of stockpiling them; fifty completions of any mix the game counts is the whole requirement. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while with your partner and escape the heat. The official description sets all three terms: be together with your partner, raise the wanted level to 4 stars, then break the police search and get clear without being caught. Deliberately staging it in free roam — raise the heat together, then hide out until the search ends — is the direct reading of the description. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — every condition is spelled out in the official description. Chain the three robberies in one continuous wanted stretch: rob, move straight to the next shop with your partner, rob again, and once more, never letting the wanted level drop in between. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — the count is the official description's. Variety is what counts, so get into vehicles you have not used before whenever you see a new model parked or passing; a hundred distinct discoveries accumulate quickly if you swap rides instead of keeping one car. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus — the count and the 'single use' limit are the official description's. Set it up before you trigger the ability: wait for a group of at least five enemies in the open, then start Combat Focus and work through them before it ends. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Flagged from the official description: it asks for one unscheduled departure at a named place, VCIA — a single set-piece moment rather than a repeatable count, so there may be no second chance once the moment passes.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The official description describes a single unscripted-feeling moment at a named place — leaving VCIA off-schedule — so when the game puts you at VCIA (the story's VCIA Takedown mission names the same place), take the departure the moment offers instead of following the scripted exit. We flag this one missable for exactly that reason; see its missable note. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke at face value — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and the only concrete noun in it is the Rhino, the tank. Read plainly, this is the list's tank trophy: get into or up against a Rhino when the game gives you one and do what the moment asks. We state only what the description supports; the description itself is the source here, and it names the Rhino and nothing more specific. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The official description sets the whole condition: the robbery must stay undetected, so plan a quiet entry, keep anyone from raising the alarm, and finish the job before you are spotted; a loud robbery that succeeds does not count. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — the count is the official description's, and note the second half: each robbery only counts once you escape, so a vault emptied and then caught is wasted effort. Work one vault at a time and get clear before starting the next. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Per the official description, both halves are required: take the truck's haul and then get away clean. One successful truck robbery with a clean escape completes it. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas, per the count in the official list data. Coverage is the task: travel every part of the map, including the corners the story never sends you to, and let the area counter tell you what is left. It pairs naturally with the meditation spots and WAiNK locations in this stage. Basis: the official description and its area count of 52.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, per the count in the official list data. One robbery per gang is the shape of it, so vary your targets instead of hitting the same gang twice, and track which gangs are done here. Basis: the official description and its gang count of 9.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Flagged from the official description: it describes one named moment — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — rather than a repeatable count, the classic shape of a trophy tied to a single scene.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The official description names the drink, the view and the place, and nothing repeatable, so treat it as a moment to take when the game sets it in front of you rather than a task to schedule later; we flag it missable on that basis (see its note). The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, ellipsis included. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Flagged from the official description: smashing out of a showroom 'in classic style' reads as one scripted set-piece in a single scene, not a free-roam action you can repeat at will.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The official description describes one set-piece — driving out through the showroom rather than leaving quietly — so when a scene puts you in a showroom with a car, take the loud exit it is pointing at. We flag it missable because the description ties it to a single scene; see its note. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The official description points at one place and one action: a follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at that named alley and complete the throw the description calls a follow-through; it names no score, so a finished visit is the plain reading. The name is printed with the curly apostrophe exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — so we say only what it supports: this is a partner trophy, earned in a moment the game stages for the two protagonists together, like the other 'with your partner' trophies on this list (Hot Together, Retail Therapy). Keep both partners together through the story's shared moments and it belongs to that set. Basis: the official description, read alongside the list's other partner trophies.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The official description says only 'Choices made (for better or worse)', and PlayStation tracks a count for it — 500, as the official list data records. Read plainly, every choice the game offers adds to the counter, so make choices whenever the game presents them instead of skipping prompts, and the total builds across the whole playthrough. Basis: the official description and its tracked count of 500.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Flagged from the official description: 'Second time's the charm' requires a first attempt that fails and a second that succeeds at the same opportunity — reload away the failure, or never fail, and the pair never happens.
trophies.guide: Succeed on the second try. The official description — 'Second time's the charm' — defines a pair: an attempt that fails, then the retry that succeeds. Do not reload a save to erase a failure before retrying; the failed first attempt is half of the requirement. We flag it missable for that reason; see its note. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: Flagged from the official description: it asks you to witness something strange ('What the hell just happened?'), and a one-off witnessed event is the classic missable shape — walk past the odd moment and it may not come again.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The official description is just a reaction — 'What the hell just happened?' — so the honest guide is: this trophy is for stumbling onto one of the game's strange one-off events, and the way to earn it is to explore off the story path and stop for odd moments instead of rushing past them. We flag it missable because witnessed events do not always repeat; see its note. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — the method is the official description's own joke ('Bowl 'em over'). From a moving vehicle, land a melee hit on a pedestrian as you pass; the trophy is for the knockdown itself, not for damage or a wanted level. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts — the amount and the method are both in the official description. It is a money total, so it accumulates: route marked bills through your contacts whenever you hold them instead of spending them another way, and the quarter-million arrives during the money stage of the roadmap. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the official description's total, spread over every shop rather than one. Ordinary play covers much of it; if you are short at the end, buy the useful stock (vehicles, property extras, gear) you were postponing rather than wasting cash. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them, per the count in the official list data. This is a money-gated collectible, so it belongs late in the roadmap once the laundering and spending trophies have built your cash; buy each garage as it becomes affordable and track the eight here. Basis: the official description and its property count of 8.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the count and the app are the official description's. Register vehicles as you acquire them rather than in one sitting at the end; ten registrations is a small total that pairs with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good. Basis: the official description.
sources: PlayStation trophy list (official name, description and grade)
